text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, a sudden injury...?
Are you all right, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Please take care of yourself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, then what about the hot springs trip we planned...?

One day, after winning many races
together with Narita Top Road—

Right before we were about to leave for the hot springs trip I won in the lottery,
I ended up with a minor fracture...
choice_data_list: Could you go with someone else instead?

text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road gets along with anyone.
There should be someone willing to go in her place, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...No, let's postpone it.
I want to help tend to the injury, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The trip I've envisioned
is something I can only do with you, Trainer.

Narita Top Road gave a gentle smile.
In the end, the hot springs trip was called off for now...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This time for sure! Well then, let's go!
Later on, once the injury had healed, we decided to go again.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was such a lovely bath!
Half-body baths are nice too, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Submerging up to your shoulders really does
warm you up best.
I made sure to count to 100 before getting out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Were you able to relax and enjoy yourself too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad.
I'm sure hot springs work wonders on old scars, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Now then, after this I'll have a meal, and then go for a walk...

Narita Top Road was enjoying herself from the bottom of her heart.
Amidst all that, however, there was one thing on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The trip I've envisioned
is something I can only do with you, Trainer.

"...Narita Top Road said that before,
but so far, she hasn't done
anything special."
What happened to the trip I had envisioned...?
choice_data_list: Hey, what kind of trip did you want to take?
Hey, what kind of trip did you want to take?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what kind of trip...? 
What I wanted was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It's just a completely ordinary hot spring trip like this, though.
choice_data_list: Still, they say it's only possible with me.
Still, you can only do it with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's what we talked about before.
What I said when we called it off that one time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san might not know this,
but to me, an ordinary hot springs trip is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It has to be with you, Trainer, or it just won't work.
No one else could ever take your place.
choice_data_list: But you're the type who can get along with anyone, right?
But you're the type who can get along with anyone, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm actually not bad at socializing
or adapting to other people.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“Still... that doesn't mean we can act completely carefree.
Courtesy is essential, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, Trainer,
I can truly just be myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Someone I can be with without a care in the world,
as natural as breathing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because it's you, Trainer, that I can relax this much.
That's why I'm glad I waited for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you from now on as well.
Both when we're running and when we're not.
choice_data_list: So that's how it is... Ah, I understand now.

text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road, the model student.
And that was precisely why—

There might only be a few people around whom
one can truly let down their guard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I promise you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: She says she'll always share the joy of racing and the rewards of her racing career with her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So please, don't get hurt anymore, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And no doing the reverse either, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, don't you go having fun behind my back,
either. Like racing against other Umamusume.

Drawing out 100% of each other's strengths
is something only this duo, with their deep mutual understanding, can do.

It was a moment where I felt an
irreplaceable bond between myself
and Narita Top Road...
